name: Tharsis Plateau
inheritance_rationale: Volcanic uplifted plateau settled in waves — the Andean parallel. Latin American horizontal-tricolor-with-charge fits a continental highland federation founded by post-independence settlers.

name: Olympus Mons
inheritance_rationale: Largest volcano in the solar system — monumental scale and the iron-red of Mars itself align with the commemorative red-field tradition reserved for objects of state-veneration.

name: Hellas Basin
inheritance_rationale: Deepest impact basin on Mars — a single bowl-shaped feature, naturally read as 'one field, one charge'. Inherits the Asian solid-emblem tradition (Japan, Bangladesh, Cambodia).

name: Argyre Basin
inheritance_rationale: From the Greek for 'silver' — argent is the heraldic tincture for silver/white. The naming itself summons heraldic vocabulary, so the flag inherits the Old-European arms-on-field convention.

name: Valles Marineris
inheritance_rationale: 4000 km canyon system — a ribbon of geography carrying a single named feature, natural fit for heraldic 'river-and-charge' conventions seen in old European riparian states.

name: Vastitas Borealis
inheritance_rationale: North polar lowlands, formerly hypothesized to be a frozen ocean. Climate parallel to the Nordic states is direct: cold, marginal, sea-bordered. Inherits the Nordic cross.

name: Planum Australe
inheritance_rationale: South polar ice cap — the second polar settlement, carrying a Nordic cross variant in family resemblance to Vastitas Borealis (the Mars equivalent of the Sweden/Finland/Norway visual sibling-set).

name: Arabia Terra
inheritance_rationale: The name is literal — Arabia Terra. Inheriting the pan-Arab tradition is irresistible and culturally legible to the new settlers naming their first regional government.

name: Terra Sirenum
inheritance_rationale: Vast cratered southern highlands — broad continental tradition fits a Slavic-style horizontal tricolor: a flag of geography, not of state, suited to a sprawling agricultural-administrative region.

name: Cydonia
inheritance_rationale: Famous for the 'Face on Mars' pareidolia — a single iconic central feature. Solid-emblem tradition (single field, single charge) commemorates the apocryphal face directly.

name: Elysium Planitia
inheritance_rationale: Eastern volcanic plain — warmer equatorial latitudes targeted for early agricultural terraforming. The Ethiopian/UNIA palette and tricolor form fit a region of continental-scale farming initiatives.

name: Amazonis Planitia
inheritance_rationale: Vast smooth lowland plain in the northern hemisphere — a Mars analogue to the US Midwest. Inherits the stars-and-stripes form: federal stripes for the constituent agro-districts, canton for the central planning council.

name: Utopia Planitia
inheritance_rationale: Tianwen-1 (China, 2021) and Viking 2 (US, 1976) landing site — by treaty, a commemorative red field marks the historic Chinese landing as one of the founding events of human Mars.

name: Acidalia Planitia
inheritance_rationale: Northern dark plain visible from Earth telescopes since the 17th century — long-known and unremarkable in topography. The 'neutral' horizontal tricolor is the right default for an unromantic plain.

name: Chryse Planitia
inheritance_rationale: Viking 1 landing site (1976) — the first successful Mars landing. Inherits solid-emblem, with the central charge commemorating the lander itself: a sacred site of human spaceflight.

name: Eridania
inheritance_rationale: Site of an ancient Hesperian-era sea — a region whose identity is its lost water. The vertical tricolor, born of the French Revolution, marks Eridania as a proud post-terraforming republic restoring its sea.

name: Aeolis
inheritance_rationale: Includes Gale Crater (Curiosity rover, 2012) and the Mount Sharp / Aeolis Mons stratigraphic record — desert-like and read as a 'lunar/desert' analogue. Star-and-crescent fits the lunar/desert symbolic vocabulary.

name: Mangala Valles
inheritance_rationale: Equatorial drainage system — warm, agricultural after terraforming. Pan-African inheritance shared with Elysium across the equatorial belt.

name: Noachis Terra
inheritance_rationale: The eponym for the Noachian era — Mars's oldest, most-cratered terrain. Inherits the heraldic tradition: oldest geology, oldest flag idiom.

name: Solis Planum
inheritance_rationale: 'Sun plateau' — the central charge of a Latin-style flag is often a sunburst (Argentina's Sol de Mayo, Uruguay, Philippines). Inheriting the Latin-charge tradition writes the Sun directly into the flag.

name: Margaritifer Terra
inheritance_rationale: From the Latin for 'pearl' — connotes maritime trade-route imagery. The British ensign tradition (settler-colonial maritime federation) fits a region settled in waves by an ocean-going power.

name: Phlegra Montes
inheritance_rationale: Northern mountain belt — long, narrow, diagonal in the Mars projection. The diagonal saltire form (St Andrew's, Burundi, Jamaica) reads naturally for a diagonal mountain-state.

name: Thaumasia Highlands
inheritance_rationale: South of Tharsis — the second large continental highland after Terra Sirenum. Shares the broad Slavic horizontal tricolor inheritance: a sister-region to Sirenum across the southern hemisphere.

name: Tempe Terra
inheritance_rationale: Northern highlands fronting Acidalia Planitia — settled by the same wave of post-revolutionary republicans as Eridania. Vertical tricolor marks them as siblings of the same political moment.

name: Terra Sabaea
inheritance_rationale: Named after the Sabaean kingdom of southern Arabia — direct cultural inheritance points to the star-and-crescent of the Islamic Ottoman tradition rather than pan-Arab (Sabaea is pre-Islamic Arabia, not Arab-revolutionary).
